Headline: IRGC says 3 oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in Hormuz — Iranian report
Timestamp: 23 November 2026, 11:18 pm (Reuters byline)
Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said three "violating" oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz that day, according to Iran's Press TV.
